name: Hearth beef
summary: Beef smoked on the hearth with mắc khén, garlic, ginger, and chili until it turns dark brown. It is fragrant, mildly hot, and still sweet.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 15 May 2025. Tổ 3, phường Chiềng Cơi.
taste: The workshop account says fragrant, mildly hot, and still sweet, for the hearth meats together.
howToEat: As the smoked beef, or carry it.
where: Phường Chiềng Cơi. No stall is a pick.
seoTitle: Bo gac bep in Son La — hearth beef
seoDescription: Thịt bò gác bếp in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La smokes it with the buffalo in Chiềng Cơi, about 6–8 hours.
